definition.simple: The part of your equity that is not tied up as margin. It shrinks as open trades lose money.
definition.balanced: Free margin = [[equity]] − used [[margin]]. It is roughly what is left to absorb further losses or to open new trades. When it nears zero, a [[margin-call]] or [[stop-out]] gets close.

example: Equity 850 USD and used margin 200 USD: free margin is 650 USD.
